ellie_sales: Merlin Catalyst wants to POC a custom v1-quant variant. Need quick compatibility check + BYOK notes. cc @jordan_se

jordan_se: We haven't validated v1-quant. Common failures: tokenizer mismatch, KV cache layout. Need tokenizer.json + config.json + small weights sample.

mira_ml: If tokenizer is standard we can shim. For quant packing, request a tiny weights tar (<2MB) or conversion script so we can test q4 kernel paths.

tomas_ops: BYOK: Dedicated/Private support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM). Hosted doesn't offer BYOK for PHI; we can offer partner-managed CMK.

ellie_sales: Customer asks about Dedicated pricing for 2xA100 reserved + a 2-week 5% canary. Ballpark?

jordan_se: Ballpark $35k-45k/mo for 2xA100 + serving license, region dependent. Canary routing: set route policy tag and weight 5%. We'll need a rollout plan.

mira_ml: Note: different 4-bit quantizers vary packing. If they used a nonstandard layout we'll need to repack or run a converter. Also quantify memory/KV spike risk at seq=512.

ellie_sales: They reported ~200ms median on their infra; target is <300ms L95 for 512 tokens. Feasible?

tomas_ops: Feasible on Dedicated with tuned batching and preferred kernels. Recommend low batch and reserved capacity. Run smoke to validate.

jordan_se: I'll run a local smoke test. Need sample payload and the artifact bundle (tokenizer.json, config.json, weights sample). Example curl I can use: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/merlin-catalyst/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input":"Summarize the key points...","max_tokens":512}'`

ellie_sales: I'll ask them to upload artifacts to secure share plus the completed security questionnaire PDF. Also confirm BYOK requirement.

deploy-bot: Ticket INF-1427 created: "merlin-catalyst preflight validations" assigned to jordan_se and mira_ml.

mira_ml: Jordan, when you run the smoke grep for KV metrics: `grep kv_size /tmp/merlin-smoke.log | sort -nr | head -n 10` and capture last 200 lines if there is kernel fallback.

jordan_se: On it, ETA ~2h.

ellie_sales: Thanks team, I'll update customer with checklist and ETA for preflight + smoke.
